_comment: Human-editable deal source. The Decap portal at /admin edits THIS file. scripts/build-promotions.mjs expands it into data/promotions.json, which the site reads. Do not edit promotions.json by hand.

deals.headline: SammyC's Skool is Live
deals.description: SammyC's Skool community is now live. Get direct access to Sam, research peptide modules, vendor intel, and community discussion.

deals.headline: 20% off first order with NEWCOFFEE20, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: New to Coffee and Peppers? Code NEWCOFFEE20 takes 20% off your first order, and SAMMYC stacks another 15% on top at checkout.

deals.headline: 25% off for military and first responders
deals.description: Solyn Labs offers 25% off for verified military and first responders, and code SAMMYC stacks on top. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor, so the prices shown here reflect the standing SAMMYC discount only. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 20% off for veterans and first responders
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides offers 20% off for verified veterans and first responders. Code SAMMYC applies 15% off for everyone else. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: SAMMYC boosted to 35% off for Labor Day
deals.description: Mile High Compounds is boosting code SAMMYC to 35% off from September 3 through September 9. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Labor Day, sale pricing plus 10% off with code LABOR, SAMMYC not valid
deals.description: Disguised Alpha is running a Labor Day sale from September 7 through September 9, ending 11:59pm Pacific. Sale pricing applies across the store, and code LABOR takes a further 10% off. The vendor advertises 20% as the total of those two together. Free FedEx 2 day shipping on US orders of $150 and over. Every order is one entry into a giveaway of $1,500 in store credit, ten winners at $150 each. Code SAMMYC cannot be combined with the LABOR code during this sale, so our usual stacked discount does not apply here. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 40% off sitewide with code FF40, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Glow Aminos is running 40% off sitewide through September 23 with code FF40. The site advertises 30% off publicly, and entering FF40 at checkout takes the discount to 40% instead. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price. Both codes are needed. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 40% off sitewide with code FF40, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Flawless Compounds is running 40% off sitewide through September 23 with code FF40. The site advertises 30% off publicly, and entering FF40 at checkout takes the discount to 40% instead. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price. Both codes are needed. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Flash Sale Friday, 15% off sitewide every Friday, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Aurora Peptides is running Flash Sale Friday every Friday starting September 11. The sale is 15% off sitewide, excluding brand goods, and it is only valid on Fridays. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 20% off. Because the sale runs one day a week, the prices shown here do not include the 15% and reflect the code only. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Build your own kit, 5% off 5 vials or 15% off 10, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Coffee and Peppers lets you build your own kit from any combination of eligible single vials, with the discount applied automatically at checkout. A half kit of 5 vials saves 5% and a full kit of 10 vials saves 15%. Original product names are kept on every vial. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price. The saving depends on kit size, so the per unit prices shown here do not include it. This offer has no end date. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Weekend sale, 20% off sitewide automatically, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Oneday Compounds is running 20% off sitewide from Friday September 11 through Sunday September 13. The discount applies automatically with no code needed. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 10% off the reduced price. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: SAMMYC boosted to 30% off through Monday
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides has boosted code SAMMYC from 15% to 30% off through midnight on Monday September 14. There is no automatic sitewide discount, the code is the offer. Confirm final pricing at checkout.
